settings.description: When enabled, continue down the configured add-on list if a provider is offline, has no match, or cannot return a playable stream.

settings.label: Strict track matching
settings.description: Require exact normalised title and artist matches. Disable only if your add-ons use inconsistent metadata.

settings.label: Duration tolerance
settings.description: Maximum duration difference accepted when both sides provide a duration.
